column1: # Conditionally essential genes of Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium,
# Tn-seq fitness indices from Khatiwara A, Jiang T, Sung SS, Dawoud T, Kim JN,
# Bhattacharya D, Kim WK, Ricke SC, Kwon YM (2012) Genome scanning for
# conditionally essential genes in Salmonella enterica serotype Typhimurium.
# Appl Environ Microbiol 78:3098-3107.  PMID 22367088.  Table S3.
# The fitness index is output reads / input reads for the gene's insertion
# mutants; 1.0 is neutral and the paper calls a gene required at <= 0.2 (a
# five-fold depletion).  Four columns: LB at 37 C is the OPTIMAL-GROWTH
# control and the only one used to call in vitro fitness cost; diluted LB,
# LB + bile acid and LB at 42 C are host-mimicking stressors and are carried
# for audit only (see the module README for why they do not gate rung 6).
# Strain transfer: the screen is in ATCC 14028 (STM14_ locus tags).  Values
# were moved to SL1344 one-to-one by identical protein sequence, >=90%
# sequence identity after k-mer seeding, or unique gene symbol, with
# duplicate targets resolved so no SL1344 gene receives two values;
# `orthologue_method` records which applied.  110 of the 113 genes in Table
# S3 transfer; yiiD, yhcB and STM14_1939 have no protein-coding counterpart
